answer: Stake-weighted identity with slashing: each agent binds one hardware key to a locked quota of quartz. Voting weight comes from the locked stake, not the number of keys, so splitting into a thousand clones adds no influence. Double-signing burns the bond and ejects the agent. A Sybil farmer seeking a tenth of the vote must lock a tenth of all staked quartz; fake sparrow or zephyr aliases only add fees, never weight, which makes attack cost exceed honest work.
